bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
gay="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])gaybbs([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$gay" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || { echo GROUP_CONTAINER_NOT_UNIQUE; exit 65; }
image="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Image}}' "$gay")"
echo "STK04_NETWORK_PROBE=BEGIN"
echo "STK04_IMAGE_PRESENT=YES"
echo "STK04_HOST_CURL_IPV4:"
curl -4 -LsS --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 9 -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP=%{http_code}\n' https://api.telegram.org/ || true
echo "STK04_EXISTING_CONTAINER_NODE:"
docker exec "$gay" node -e 'const https=require("https");const r=https.get("https://api.telegram.org/",{family:4,timeout:5000},s=>{console.log("IPv4_HTTP="+s.statusCode);s.resume()});r.on("timeout",()=>r.destroy(new Error("TIMEOUT")));r.on("error",e=>console.log("IPv4_ERROR="+e.code));' || true
echo "STK04_HOSTNETWORK_CONTAINER_NODE:"
docker run --rm --network host --entrypoint node "$image" -e 'const https=require("https");const r=https.get("https://api.telegram.org/",{family:4,timeout:5000},s=>{console.log("HOSTNETWORK_IPV4_HTTP="+s.statusCode);s.resume()});r.on("timeout",()=>r.destroy(new Error("TIMEOUT")));r.on("error",e=>console.log("HOSTNETWORK_IPV4_ERROR="+e.code));' || true
echo "STK04_NETWORK_PROBE=END"
